title: FNAF 2 Scream
blurb: Toy animatronics, it turned out, were not remotely toys. The 2014 sequel's shriek is sharper and thinner than the original's, all treble and clipping, engineered to slice through whatever volume you thought was safe. FNAF 2 also removed the doors, so the only real defence was a Freddy mask and your reflexes — meaning this scream is almost always the sound of hesitating for half a second too long. Essential for horror edits, reaction bait, and completing the Freddy's arsenal alongside the first game's scream. The night shift never once gets easier.
origin: The jumpscare scream from Five Nights at Freddy's 2.
